description: This Java class 'ComponentResourceHandler' manages resource information for components, providing methods to load and access resource data such as XML documents, URLs, and streams, based on component name, loader, and location.

classes.name: ComponentResourceHandler
classes.description: Handles component resource details, including loading XML documents, streams, and URLs based on component configuration.

methods.name: ComponentResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with component name and XML element, extracting loader and location attributes.

methods.name: ComponentResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with component name, loader, and location; logs creation if verbose mode is on.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name associated with the resource.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the resource.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML document from the resource stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Provides the URL of the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource is a file resource.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location path of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on loader, component, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on component, loader, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the resource handler.
